title: ReTrace: Distilling Tool-Using Agents into Planner-Free Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2611.14492v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Business process automation runs the same Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) again and again on new inputs. Large Language Model (LLM) agents can follow an SOP written in natural language, but they call an LLM to choose every step of every run, which adds latency and cost at scale. We present ReTrace, which turns an SOP and a few logged agent runs into a reusable workflow in which code, not an LLM, selects the next step. The agent's reasoning, the explanation it writes with each tool call, often states why it took an action; the tool calls alone do not. ReTrace extracts the condition behind each step, merges these conditions across runs into a compact rule document, and generates an executable workflow from it. Only this last stage depends on the platform, so rule documents can be compiled for different orchestration platforms. On $79$ procedures from our production platform, ReTrace workflows reach $93.8\%$ completion, against $96.8\%$

translated_title: ReTrace：将使用工具的智能体蒸馏为无规划器的工作流
translated_abstract: 业务流程自动化会在新的输入上反复运行相同的标准操作程序（SOP）。大型语言模型（LLM）智能体能够遵循用自然语言编写的SOP，但每次运行时都需要调用LLM来选择每一步，这在大规模应用中增加了延迟和成本。我们提出了ReTrace，它将SOP和少量记录下来的智能体运行日志转化为可复用的工作流，在该工作流中由代码而非LLM来选择下一步。智能体的推理过程——即它在每次工具调用时写下的解释——通常说明了它采取某个动作的原因，而仅有工具调用记录则无法体现这一点。ReTrace提取每个步骤背后的条件，将这些条件跨多次运行合并为一份精简的规则文档，并据此生成可执行的工作流。只有最后这一阶段依赖于具体平台，因此规则文档可以针对不同的编排平台进行编译。在我们生产平台上的79个流程中，ReTrace工作流达到93.8%的完成率，相比之下（基线）为96.8%。
tldr: ReTrace通过从智能体的推理解释中提取每步背后的条件并跨运行合并为规则文档，将SOP和少量智能体运行日志蒸馏成由代码驱动的无规划器可执行工作流，在大规模流程自动化中以更低的延迟和成本实现接近LLM智能体的完成率（93.8%对96.8%）。
en_tdlr: ReTrace distills an SOP and a few logged agent runs into a planner-free, code-driven executable workflow by extracting the conditions behind each step from the agent's reasoning and merging them into a compact rule document, achieving near-parity completion rates (93.8% vs 96.8%) with far lower latency and cost than LLM agents.
